headline: Google Colab: 1 limit changed (added “What kinds of files does Data Science Agent s…”)
added: What kinds of files does Data Science Agent support? Data Science Agent accepts files of many types including CSV, TSV, JSON, XLS, XLSX, XLSM, XLSB, ODF, ODS, ODT, and TXT. Files can be as large as 1GB.
How many files can Data Science Agent analyze at a time? You can use Data Science Agent to analyze a single file or up to 5 files at the same time.
How do I provide feedback on Data Science Agent? We would love to hear from you! Feel free give us thumbs feedback in the Gemini side panel or report feedback in product ("Help > Send feedback").

Google Colab: pricing page text changed (no price or limit change detected)
added: Are Colab benefits included with a Google One free trial? No. Premium Colab benefits are only available to paid Google AI plan subscribers. They are not included during a free trial of a Google One plan (for example, a promotional or extended free trial). Your Colab benefits begin once your paid subscription is active.
